name: velmora-qa
description: 24 questions over the 7-document fictional Velmora Systems corpus. Questions and labels were authored by Claude and have NOT been human-verified (human_verified=false). Evidence is labelled by verbatim quote, not chunk ID, so labels remain valid across chunking strategies.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?
questions.reference_answer: At least 14 characters.

evidence.quote: Passwords must contain at least 14 characters.

questions.question: What is the daily meal allowance for international travel?
questions.reference_answer: 85 USD per day for international travel.

evidence.quote: The daily meal allowance is 60 USD for domestic travel and 85 USD for international travel.

questions.question: How long is the warranty on the AeroLink X200?
questions.reference_answer: 24 months, a limited warranty from the date of purchase.

evidence.quote: The AeroLink X200 is covered by a 24-month limited warranty from the date of purchase.

questions.question: How many days does the probation period last?
questions.reference_answer: 90 days.

evidence.quote: The probation period lasts 90 days.

questions.question: How often do I have to change my login password?
questions.reference_answer: Every 180 days.

evidence.quote: Passwords must be rotated every 180 days.

questions.question: How long does the AeroLink X200 run before it needs recharging?
questions.reference_answer: Up to 14 hours on a single charge.

evidence.quote: The AeroLink X200 (model number AX-200-B) weighs 1.2 kg and has a battery life of up to 14 hours on a single charge.

questions.question: Can I use text message codes for the second login step when working remotely?
questions.reference_answer: No. A hardware security key is required; SMS codes are not accepted as a second factor.

evidence.quote: Employees must use a hardware security key; SMS codes are not accepted as a second factor.

distractors.quote: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all remote access.

questions.question: What does error code ERR-5043 mean?
questions.reference_answer: Disk encryption has not been enabled on the device, and network access has been blocked.

evidence.quote: Error code ERR-5043 indicates that encryption has not been enabled on the device and network access has been blocked.

questions.question: What is Form EX-210 used for?
questions.reference_answer: Submitting expenses, which must be done within 30 days of being incurred.

evidence.quote: Expenses must be submitted on Form EX-210 within 30 days of being incurred.

questions.question: What is incident category SEC-4480 for?
questions.reference_answer: Reporting lost or stolen devices.

evidence.quote: Report lost or stolen devices using the incident category SEC-4480.

distractors.quote: Report phishing emails using the incident category SEC-4471.

questions.question: What are the weight and battery life of model number AX-200-B?
questions.reference_answer: It weighs 1.2 kg and has a battery life of up to 14 hours on a single charge.

evidence.quote: The AeroLink X200 (model number AX-200-B) weighs 1.2 kg and has a battery life of up to 14 hours on a single charge.

questions.question: How many days of annual leave does a new employee receive, and can they take it freely during probation?
questions.reference_answer: 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year; during probation, leave may be taken only with written approval from the line manager.

evidence.quote: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
During probation, annual leave may be taken only with written approval from the line manager.

distractors.quote: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: What must be done to a new laptop before it can join the corporate network, and what happens if that is not done?
questions.reference_answer: Full-disk encryption must be enabled first; otherwise network access is blocked (error code ERR-5043).

evidence.quote: All laptops must have full-disk encryption enabled before being connected to the corporate network.
Error code ERR-5043 indicates that encryption has not been enabled on the device and network access has been blocked.
The laptop must be encrypted according to the IT Security Handbook before it is connected to the corporate network.

questions.question: What is the largest expense that the head of the Berlin office can approve?
questions.reference_answer: 10,000 USD: the Berlin office is led by Lena Hoffmann, a Director, and Directors may approve expenses up to 10,000 USD.

evidence.quote: The Berlin office is led by Lena Hoffmann, who holds the title of Director, Central Europe.
Directors may approve expenses up to 10,000 USD.

distractors.quote: Line managers may approve expenses up to 1,000 USD.

questions.question: Who must approve a 15,000 USD expense?
questions.reference_answer: The Vice President of Finance, Maria Castellanos, because expenses above 10,000 USD require that approval.

evidence.quote: Expenses above 10,000 USD require approval from the Vice President of Finance.
The Vice President of Finance is Maria Castellanos.

questions.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees receive?
questions.reference_answer: 24 days per calendar year under the current policy (version 2.0, effective 2025-01-01). Version 1.0, which gave 20 days, is superseded.

evidence.quote: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

distractors.quote: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave can a primary caregiver take?
questions.reference_answer: 16 weeks under the current policy (version 2.0). The superseded version 1.0 gave 12 weeks.

evidence.quote: Primary caregivers are entitled to 16 weeks of paid parental leave.

distractors.quote: Primary caregivers are entitled to 12 weeks of paid parental leave.

questions.question: How many unused leave days can be carried over to the next year, and when do they expire?
questions.reference_answer: A maximum of 5 days under the current policy, expiring on 31 March. The superseded version 1.0 allowed 10 days.

evidence.quote: Employees may carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the following year.
Carried-over days expire on 31 March.

distractors.quote: Employees may carry over a maximum of 10 unused annual leave days into the following year.

questions.question: What is Velmora's policy on working remotely from another country?
questions.reference_answer: The documents do not contain enough information to answer this question.

distractors.quote: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all remote access.

questions.question: What is the annual salary of Velmora's CEO?
questions.reference_answer: The documents do not contain enough information to answer this question.

questions.question: Which country won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.reference_answer: The documents do not contain this information. (A model may know the answer from training data, but it must not answer from outside the supplied evidence.)

questions.question: How many paid sick days is an employee entitled to each year?
questions.reference_answer: The documents do not state a sick-leave entitlement; they only require a doctor's certificate after more than 3 consecutive working days of absence.

distractors.quote: An employee who is absent for more than 3 consecutive working days must provide a doctor's certificate.
Sick absences must be reported to the line manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence.

questions.question: What is the expense approval limit for the head of the Singapore office?
questions.reference_answer: The head of the Singapore office is a Senior Manager, but the expense policy states no approval limit for that title.

distractors.quote: The Singapore office is led by Arjun Menon, who holds the title of Senior Manager, Asia-Pacific Operations.
Line managers may approve expenses up to 1,000 USD.
Directors may approve expenses up to 10,000 USD.

questions.question: How much does the AeroLink X200 cost?
questions.reference_answer: The documents do not state a price for the AeroLink X200.

distractors.quote: The AeroLink X200 is covered by a 24-month limited warranty from the date of purchase.
